name: adcopilot-x-ads-plugin
description: AdCopilot for X Ads (Twitter Ads): reads and reviews the X ad accounts you connect (read only), checks your X Pixel in Google Tag Manager, reports X traffic and conversions in Google Analytics (GA4), and drafts campaign plans, post copy and budget pacing math. Made by Atromx Intelligence, not by X.

plugins.name: adcopilot-x-ads
plugins.description: Reads your connected X ad accounts (read only) and audits them, checks your X Pixel in Google Tag Manager, reports X traffic and conversions in Google Analytics (GA4), checks UTM tags, guides conversion setup, plans campaigns, drafts post copy and does budget pacing math. It changes nothing in your X ad account.
